name: Mountain Pose
description: The foundational standing pose: feet grounded, spine tall, arms by the sides.

source.title: Yoga Journal Pose Library
source.note: Stick-figure approximation. Twists and binds can't be fully shown in 2D.

setup: Stand with your feet hip-width apart or big toes touching.
Let your arms hang by your sides with your palms facing in or forward.

keyframes.name: Mountain Pose
keyframes.cue: Lift through the crown, relax the shoulders, palms forward.

cues: Spread the weight evenly through both feet.
